findings: After a rollback the pointer's commit field holds the short hash taken from the release id, where a release writes the full one. Nothing reads it for anything but display.
A rollback takes about a minute from the click to the pointer moving, almost all of it the workflow starting.
A release on its page in an open browser tab was not examined: the checks opened fresh pages. What a player with a page already open sees across a rollback is not tested.
